text: 今年以来，国内二手车交易市场整体稳中有升，新能源二手车交易量持续走高。中国汽车流通协会数据显示，今年上半年，我国二手车交易量接近新车，部分二手车的价格基本是新车的一半。新能源二手车市场继续快速增长，今年上半年新能源二手车的交易量达到了83.9万辆，同比增长22%，新能源二手车占整体二手车交易量达到了8.6%。多地二手车商表示，新能源二手车越来越受消费者青睐，核心是消费者购车理念愈发理性，同时市场车源供给也更加充足。随着消费需求升级、车源不断扩容，二手车行业的内部经营结构也在发生变化。各地接连出台利好政策，优化二手车流通环节，为二手车市场尤其是新能源二手车
text_en: Since the start of this year, China's used car market has been steadily rising overall, with new-energy used car transaction volumes continuing to climb. China Automobile Dealers Association data shows that in the first half of this year, used car sales approached those of new cars, with some used car prices roughly half of new cars. The new-energy used car market continues rapid growth, with first-half volumes reaching 839,000 units, up 22% year-on-year, accounting for 8.6% of total used car transactions. Many used car dealers say new-energy used cars are increasingly favored by consumers, driven by more rational purchasing attitudes and more abundant market supply. As consumer demand upgrades and inventory expands, the industry's internal operating structure is also changing.
